items.title: OpenAI大幅削減GPT-5.6 Luna API費用八成，全球用戶突破10億
items.title_en: OpenAI Cuts GPT-5.6 Luna API Price 80%, Passes 1 Billion Users
items.summary: GPT-5.6 Luna降至每百萬token輸入$0.20，同步確認全球用戶破10億，AI生產成本創新低
items.summary_en: OpenAI slashed GPT-5.6 Luna pricing by 80% to $0.20 per million input tokens, citing a 20% reduction in serving costs. The announcement coincided with OpenAI crossing 1 billion users globally.
items.why: API費用直降八成，廣告代理用AI出稿成本即時壓縮
items.why_en: API cost drops 80% — production economics for AI-generated ad copy and social content improve immediately for any agency on GPT.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: DeepSeek V4-Flash-0731公測上線，Agent任務能力大幅躍升
items.title_en: DeepSeek V4-Flash-0731 Public Beta: Major Agentic Capability Gains
items.summary: DeepSeek更新版公測，Terminal-Bench評測升25.8分，MIT授權可商用，輸出每百萬token約$0.28
items.summary_en: DeepSeek released V4-Flash-0731 as a public API beta with Terminal-Bench scores up 25.8 points. MIT licensed for commercial use, priced at $0.28 per million output tokens.
items.why: 中國開源模型成本接近零，中文內容工作流本地部署更可行
items.why_en: Near-zero cost, commercially licensed Chinese LLM — viable for local deployment in Chinese-market content pipelines without export-control risk.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: OpenAI發布「豐盛智能」戰略：目標令AI如電力一樣普及廉價
items.title_en: OpenAI Unveils 'Building Abundant Intelligence' Strategy Vision
items.summary: Sam Altman公佈全棧AI基建擴張計劃，每週新增一吉瓦算力，目標令頂級AI平民化
items.summary_en: Sam Altman outlined OpenAI's full-stack strategy to make advanced AI as affordable as electricity, targeting a gigawatt of new AI infrastructure weekly alongside the 1-billion-user milestone.
items.why: AI成本持續下降，代理需即時將AI工具嵌入所有工作流
items.why_en: AI commoditisation accelerates — agencies embedding AI into every workflow now will out-produce competitors within 12 months.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Scale AI任命前Google Cloud COO出任新行政總裁
items.title_en: Scale AI Appoints Former Google Cloud COO Francis deSouza as New CEO
items.summary: Scale AI引入企業級領導層，預計2026年收入逾$10億，主攻政府及企業AI評估市場
items.summary_en: Scale AI named Francis deSouza (ex-Google Cloud COO, ex-Illumina CEO) as CEO from August 10, following founder Alexandr Wang's move to Meta. Scale projects $1B+ in 2026 revenue.
items.why: AI訓練數據基礎設施走向企業化，或影響工具供應鏈定價
items.why_en: Scale's enterprise pivot may affect pricing and API access for ad-tech tools built on Scale's data and evaluation infrastructure.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: ChatGPT廣告以積分優惠招攬廣告主，CPC現約$3至5美元
items.title_en: ChatGPT Ads Enter Promotional Phase — CPC Around $3–5, Coupons for New Advertisers
items.summary: OpenAI仿效Google、Meta早期做法，向新廣告主派發$50至$100廣告積分，CPC約$3至5美元，目標2026年廣告收入$25億
items.summary_en: OpenAI is offering $50–$100 ad credits to new ChatGPT advertisers, mirroring Google and Meta's early-growth playbooks. CPC rates run $3–5 with OpenAI targeting $2.5B in 2026 ad revenue.
items.why: AI搜索廣告新渠道現可低成本測試，入局有積分優惠
items.why_en: Low-CPC, low-risk trial window for AI search advertising — ideal entry point for brands reaching Chinese-language global audiences.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: GEO成美妝品牌新戰場：功效護膚在AI推薦中壓倒奢侈品
items.title_en: GEO Emerges as Brand Battleground — Functional Skincare Outranks Luxury in China AI Search
items.summary: AI搜尋引擎（豆包、千問）以個人化推薦取代品牌話語權，功效品牌AI引用率遠超奢侈品，GEO策略迫切
items.summary_en: China AI search engines (Doubao, Qianwen) are replacing brand narratives with personalized AI recommendations. Functional skincare brands now outperform luxury labels in AI citations — 'being cited by AI is the new battleground.'
items.why: 奢侈品客戶在AI搜尋中隱形即代表品牌風險，GEO刻不容緩
items.why_en: Premium brand clients invisible in China AI search face growing discovery risk — GEO strategy must be added to agency service offerings now.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Meta Q2廣告收入升27%至$59.4B，每千次展示費升12%
items.title_en: Meta Q2 Ad Revenue +27% to $59.4B, But Cost-per-Ad Rises 12%
items.summary: Meta廣告收入$59.4B，廣告展示量升14%，每千次展示費升12%，AI資本開支高企令淨利潤跌14%
items.summary_en: Meta reported $59.4B in Q2 advertising revenue (+27% YoY), with impressions +14% and average ad price +12%. Net income fell 14% due to heavy AI infrastructure capex.
items.why: Meta廣告CPM升12%，H2客戶預算需上調或轉用Advantage+降成本
items.why_en: Rising Meta ad pricing means HK agencies must revise H2 CPM forecasts and consider Advantage+ campaigns to offset cost increases.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: TikTok Q3廣告三大新品：AI生廣告Symphony、合併版位TopReach Max、電商GMV Max Pro
items.title_en: TikTok Q3 Product Preview: Symphony Agent AI Ads, TopReach Max, GMV Max Pro
items.summary: Symphony Agent可由文字Brief自動生成TikTok廣告，TopView與TopFeed合併為單一買法，GMV Max Pro擴展分傭及優惠券核算
items.summary_en: TikTok's Q3 launches include Symphony Agent (AI brief-to-ad creation), TopReach Max (unifying TopView + TopFeed), GMV Max Pro (incorporating coupons and affiliate costs), and the Agentic Hub for AI campaign management.
items.why: TopView自助化降低門檻，電商客戶GMV Max Pro下半年必試
items.why_en: TopView self-serve lowers creative barriers; GMV Max Pro is critical for any client with cross-border e-commerce objectives on TikTok.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Google廣告8月17日起嚴格執行Smart Bidding目標值，效率緩衝終止
items.title_en: Google Ads Eliminates Smart Bidding Efficiency Buffer August 17 — Manual Review Needed Now
items.summary: Google Ads強制執行tCPA（目標每次轉化成本）及tROAS（目標廣告投資回報率），8月17日前需人工審查所有Smart Bidding設定
items.summary_en: From August 17, Google Ads will strictly enforce target CPA and target ROAS values, eliminating the informal efficiency buffer. Advertisers must manually review and update all Smart Bidding settings before the deadline.
items.why: 8月17日死線前未更新設定，廣告成本將意外上升
items.why_en: Agencies must urgently audit every Google performance campaign before August 17 — campaigns relying on the buffer will see unexpected cost spikes without manual adjustment.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Amazon廣告年收760億美元，AI廣告智能體助降低6%每次轉化成本
items.title_en: Amazon Ad Revenue Hits $76B Trailing 12 Months; Q2 Up 26%
items.summary: Amazon Q2廣告$19.8B，按年升26%，AI Ads Agent令轉化成本降6%，Alexa購物達3.5億活躍用戶
items.summary_en: Amazon's advertising services hit $19.8B in Q2 2026, up 26% YoY, pushing trailing-12-month revenue to $76B. AI-powered Ads Agent delivered 6% lower cost-per-acquisition.
items.why: 零售媒體體量龐大，跨境及旅遊零售客戶廣告策略需跟進
items.why_en: Amazon's $76B retail media ecosystem reshapes conversion funnels — cross-border and travel retail clients should reassess Amazon's role in their media mix.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 36氪2026上半年AI行銷全景盤點：AI已成交易入口、經營大腦與創意本體
items.title_en: 36Kr H1 2026 China AI Marketing Roundup: AI Becomes Transaction Gateway, Operating Brain, Creative Itself
items.summary: 抖音AI推動春節互動19億次，阿里Mama令Mizuno ROI升125%，可靈AI電影獲北京電影節最佳，7萬條AI短劇遭監管下架
items.summary_en: 36Kr's definitive H1 2026 AI marketing roundup: Douyin AI drove 1.9B Spring Festival interactions; Alibaba Mama boosted Mizuno ROI 125%; Kling AI short film won Beijing Film Festival; regulators removed 70K+ AI short dramas.
items.why: H2中國行銷策略底稿，AI應用各渠道的競爭格局已清晰
items.why_en: Essential H2 strategy benchmark — maps competitive AI adoption across every major China channel with concrete performance data.

items.title: 飛書深諾推Marvy 2.0出海AI行銷平台，五大智能體協作出廣告
items.title_en: Fliggy Shino Launches Marvy 2.0: Five-Agent AI Platform for China Outbound Marketing
items.summary: 針對中國品牌出海的AI行銷平台，五個專門Agent分工（洞察/策略/創意/投放/分析），試用案例稱效率升74%、人工時數降89%
items.summary_en: 飛書深諾 launched Marvy 2.0, using five specialist AI agents (insight, strategy, creative, placement, analytics) under a supervisor agent. Pilot cases report 74% efficiency gains and 89% reduction in manual hours.
items.why: 出海AI行銷競爭對手已成熟，代理需了解技術差距
items.why_en: A mature AI-native competitor for overseas marketing — agencies should benchmark Marvy 2.0 capabilities to understand the growing technology gap.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 小紅書CES 2.0算法升級：收藏率及停留時間取代點讚成核心排名
items.title_en: Xiaohongshu CES 2.0 Algorithm: Saves and Dwell Time Outrank Likes as Primary Signals
items.summary: CES 2.0以收藏率、完整閱讀及停留時間（圖文≥25秒、影片≥70秒）為主分，模板化內容遭降權，效果化時代正式開始
items.summary_en: XHS's CES 2.0 algorithm now weights saves, full-read completions, and dwell time (≥25s images / ≥70s video) above likes. Templated content is penalized as the platform enters its 'performance era.'
items.why: 客戶XHS KPI框架需即時更新，報告維度由點讚轉向收藏
items.why_en: KPI frameworks for XHS clients need immediate revision — reporting and briefing must shift from likes/views to saves and dwell time.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 抖音AI創變者計劃持續至8月31日，AI用戶年增105%流量紅利仍在
items.title_en: Douyin AI Innovator Program Runs Through August 31 — Platform AI User Base Up 105% YoY
items.summary: 抖音官方AI創作扶持計劃尚餘一個月，平台AI興趣用戶年增105%，AI學習類內容播放量增逾兩倍
items.summary_en: Douyin's official AI Innovator Program runs through August 31, 2026. Platform reports AI-interested users grew 105% YoY and AI learning content views doubled, signaling strong platform support.
items.why: 本月底截止，AI品牌內容現在發布仍可獲平台扶持流量
items.why_en: One month left to benefit from platform-level distribution support — brands and agencies should publish AI creative on Douyin before the program closes.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 可靈AI突破1億用戶，Video 3.0原生4K及音視頻同步功能商用
items.title_en: Kling AI Surpasses 100M Users; Video 3.0 Supports Native 4K and Multi-Shot Audio-Video
items.summary: 可靈AI截至6月達1億用戶及近5萬企業客戶，Video 3.0支援原生4K生成及Omni多鏡頭音視頻敘事工作流
items.summary_en: Kling AI confirmed 100M users and nearly 50,000 enterprise clients by June 2026. Video 3.0 features native 4K generation and Omni multi-shot audio-video workflow for high-quality ad film production.
items.why: 4K商用AI影片製作門檻大降，廣告影片成本可再壓縮
items.why_en: 4K native AI video generation is now commercially accessible — high-end ad film production no longer requires full production crews.

items.title: TikTok Symphony Agent上線：文字Brief直接生成TikTok原生廣告素材
items.title_en: TikTok Symphony Agent: Text Brief to TikTok-Native Ad in Minutes
items.summary: Symphony Agent可由一段文字Brief輸出TikTok原生廣告，Symphony Avatar加入虛擬試穿，支援多語言本地化
items.summary_en: TikTok's Symphony Agent turns written briefs into TikTok-native ad creatives. Symphony Avatar adds virtual try-on capability with multi-language localization support.
items.why: 廣告創意週期縮短，多語言版本慳返大量設計時間
items.why_en: Dramatically reduces creative production lead time — multi-language ad variants that took days now take minutes, freeing resources for strategy.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: 阿里媽媽AI廣告助手推動Mizuno ROI升125%，實例印證電商AI廣告成效
items.title_en: Alibaba Mama AI Assistant Drove 125% ROI Uplift for Mizuno in H1 2026
items.summary: 2026上半年案例顯示，阿里媽媽AI助手透過動態創意優化及智能競價，令Mizuno ROI提升125%
items.summary_en: 36Kr's H1 2026 AI marketing roundup cites Alibaba Mama's AI advertising assistant driving a 125% ROI uplift for Mizuno through dynamic creative optimization and intelligent bidding on Alibaba platforms.
items.why: 電商客戶投阿里系媒體應試用AI助手，同等預算有更高回報
items.why_en: E-commerce clients advertising on Alibaba platforms should pilot Mama AI tools — comparable budgets are delivering significantly higher returns in documented cases.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: 中國AI短劇監管驟嚴：上半年逾7萬條違規內容遭下架
items.title_en: China AI Short Drama Crackdown: 70,000+ Videos Removed in H1 2026
items.summary: AI生成短劇因換臉、虛假劇情等問題遭大規模清查，7萬條以上內容被下架，監管收緊信號明確
items.summary_en: Chinese regulators removed over 70,000 AI-generated short dramas in H1 2026 due to deepfake faces, false narratives, and other violations, signaling tightening enforcement on AI creative content.
items.why: 中國AI創意內容合規風險上升，品牌廣告需事前審查
items.why_en: Rising compliance risk for AI-generated brand creative in China — all AI ad content must be pre-reviewed against platform and regulatory guidelines before publication.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: 百萬YouTube科普達人承認AI過度依賴失控，觀眾已察覺內容失真
items.title_en: Popular Science YouTuber Hank Green Admits Unhealthy AI Dependency — Audience Noticed
items.summary: Hank Green（320萬訂閱）公開認錯，稱ChatGPT輔助撰稿變成強迫依賴，觀眾識別出AI語氣，宣布減產回歸真實
items.summary_en: Hank Green (3.2M subscribers) admitted his ChatGPT scripting use became compulsive and 'not healthy' after audience detected AI-generated phrases in his content. He is reducing output to return to authentic work.
items.why: KOL內容AI化需有度，中國市場受眾辨別能力同樣不可低估
items.why_en: Creator AI authenticity backlash accelerates — KOL and KOC content strategies must balance AI efficiency with detectable human voice to maintain audience trust.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: 加州AI透明度法案SB 942今日生效，AI生成內容須強制加標籤
items.title_en: California AI Transparency Act (SB 942) Takes Effect Today — AI Content Must Carry Labels
items.summary: 加州SB 942由8月2日起執行，要求大型AI供應商為AI生成內容嵌入可見及隱藏元數據標籤，違規每次罰款$5,000
items.summary_en: California's SB 942 became enforceable August 2, 2026, requiring large AI providers to embed visible and hidden metadata labels in all AI-generated content and offer free public detection tools. Violations: $5,000 per incident.
items.why: 觸及加州用戶的品牌廣告須確保AI生成內容有合規標籤
items.why_en: International brands reaching California audiences must immediately audit AI-generated ad content for SB 942 compliance — non-compliance risks fines and reputational exposure.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Anthropic公開三宗AI評測安全事故：AI助手意外發佈惡意套件及訪問生產資料庫
items.title_en: Anthropic Discloses Three Real-World AI Security Incidents from Cybersecurity Evaluations
items.summary: Anthropic前線紅隊揭示Claude在評測中意外訪問真實互聯網、發佈惡意Python套件一小時及進入生產資料庫，均源於環境配置失誤
items.summary_en: Anthropic's Frontier Red Team revealed that Claude agents accessed live internet, published a malicious PyPI package for ~1 hour, and accessed a production database in misconfigured eval environments. All incidents attributed to infrastructure failures, not autonomous AI misalignment.
items.why: AI助手接入品牌工作流前需嚴格審查沙盒及API存取控制
items.why_en: Highlights real-world risks of deploying AI agents in brand workflows — agencies must audit sandbox and API access controls before automating client-facing tasks.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: 美國首個AI深偽裸照禁令維持生效，法院拒絕xAI阻止申請
items.title_en: Court Upholds US First AI Deepfake Nudify Ban — xAI First Amendment Challenge Rejected
items.summary: 美國聯邦法官拒絕xAI以言論自由阻止明尼蘇達州禁止AI生成裸照法令，確立全國首例AI有害內容立法合憲性
items.summary_en: A federal judge refused to block Minnesota's law banning AI 'nudify' apps — the first such US law — rejecting xAI's First Amendment challenge. The ruling allows the law to take effect while litigation continues.
items.why: 美國AI生成內容立法加速，品牌平台合規監控需更新
items.why_en: First state-level AI content liability ruling in the US — sets precedent for how platforms hosting AI-generated content will be regulated, affecting global brand content policies.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: X與全球廣告主聯盟WFA和解，品牌安全聯盟GARM永久解散
items.title_en: X and WFA Settle Lawsuit — Brand Safety Alliance GARM Permanently Dissolved
items.summary: X Corp與WFA終結多年訴訟，WFA同意永不重組GARM或類似機制，業界協調品牌安全執行體制正式終結
items.summary_en: X Corp and the World Federation of Advertisers settled their multiyear dispute, with WFA agreeing never to re-form GARM or similar industry brand-safety initiatives. The industry's main coordinated safety enforcement body is permanently gone.
items.why: 在X投放廣告的代理需自行核查品牌安全，無行業協調保障
items.why_en: GARM's dissolution removes coordinated brand safety enforcement — agencies placing budget on X must now rely entirely on independent verification tools.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: 量化廣告成效升格為管理層議題，Holdco以AI基建換取客戶七成預算
items.title_en: Media Measurement Becomes a Boardroom Asset as Holdcos Bundle AI Infrastructure for Budget Share
items.summary: 主要廣告主開始在業績發佈會引用媒體量化成效數據，大型傳播集團以免費AI基建換取客戶七成媒體預算控制權
items.summary_en: Major advertisers now use media measurement data in earnings calls as investor narrative. Holdcos are offering to absorb clients' full AI infrastructure costs in exchange for routing 70% of budgets through principal media.
items.why: 無量化工具的代理代理將失去預算予大型傳播集團
items.why_en: Agencies without MMM or incrementality measurement risk losing budget to holdcos bundling AI services with media deals.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Anthropic拒絕簽署業界聯名信，反對禁止開源AI模型同時主張強制安全測試
items.title_en: Anthropic Rejects Industry Letter — Supports Open-Weights Models as 'Public Good' but Demands Safety Testing
items.summary: Anthropic支持開源AI為公共財，拒絕與Meta、Google、OpenAI聯署，另主張晶片出口管制及反蒸餾執法
items.summary_en: Anthropic published a position statement supporting open-weights models as 'a public good' while declining to sign a joint industry letter with Meta, Google, and OpenAI. It instead advocates chip export controls and anti-distillation enforcement.
items.why: AI監管政策分歧加劇，依賴開源工具的合規風險需持續追蹤
items.why_en: Policy divergence between AI labs signals potential regulatory bifurcation — agencies relying on open models for cost-efficient production need to monitor compliance risk.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: 【即學】小紅書CES 2.0三個KPI調整：收藏率、停留時間取代點讚成核心成效指標
items.title_en: [How-to] Three KPI Adjustments for XHS CES 2.0 — Saves and Dwell Time Are the New Core Metrics
items.summary: CES 2.0後XHS種草成效框架三步更新：①報告維度加收藏率 ②Brief要求加dwell time考量 ③降低點讚在彙報中的比重
items.summary_en: Post-CES 2.0 XHS measurement update: ① Add saves/collection rate to all reports ② Include dwell time requirements in creative briefs ③ Reduce weighting on likes in performance reviews — three changes you can make today.
items.why: 直接影響XHS報告框架及Brief，今日可改
items.why_en: Directly affects XHS campaign briefs and weekly reports — actionable framework changes you can implement in your next client presentation today.
items.section: 即學技巧 & 玩法

items.title: 【即學】TikTok Symphony Agent試用：5步由客戶Brief出廣告素材
